Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely included “Abigail Breslin father” in the initial search plan, conflating the original 2008 film (where Abigail Breslin played Nim) with the 2013 sequel Return to Nim’s Island (where Bindi Irwin played Nim). This misdirection could lead to the wrong father (Michael Breslin) instead of the correct answer, Steve Irwin.
